title: Kubernetes
summary: For the CKAD first, and the CKA later. The exam is done in a terminal, so recall on the boards comes with tasks to do on a cluster of your own.

core-group.title: The core group
core-group.body: Pods, Services, ConfigMaps and the other original resources belong to the core API group, which has no name. Their apiVersion is therefore just v1, where every other group's is group/version, as in apps/v1.
